notes:
Account summary
- Northstar HR is evaluating Redwood for production LLM inference powering recruiter-facing workflows (candidate summary + doc Q&A over resumes/ATS notes) and internal support-agent for ops.
- Core requirement: strict latency SLA + predictable tail latency under load. They have had regressions during model rollouts and want automated safety rails.

Firmographics / environment
- Currently running mixed workloads: real-time chat-style generation + embeddings for search.
- Deployment preference: VPC/private networking (no public egress for inference traffic). Us-east primary; they require EU data residency for a subset of customers.
- Compliance asks: SOC2 alignment, SSO/SAML, audit logging + export, retention controls. KMS integration requested.

Key requirements (captured from calls)
- Latency SLO targets (their words):
  - "We cannot exceed p95 ~350ms for short responses" (chat completion for agent assist). They also track p99 and want explicit tail reporting.
  - Error budget: <0.25% 5xx at steady state; spikes during rollout are unacceptable.
  - Wants per-route/per-region SLO monitors that are directly tied to rollout decisions.
- Rollout safety:
  - Must support canary/A-B traffic splits and staged model deployments.
  - Must automatically pause/rollback when latency or error-rate SLO breaches occur.
  - Wants configurable thresholds by route/model/region/customer tier.
  - Needs audit trail: "why did you rollback" with monitor IDs + a metrics snapshot + who/what triggered it.
  - Wants admin-only override/suppression window with justification logged.
- Observability:
  - Needs dashboards for rollout health + explicit alerting when an auto-rollback triggers.
  - Explicit concern about monitor staleness/lag; wants clear behavior documented.
